# Panther — Trusted Vehicle Pricing & Transactions in Nigeria
> Panther is the pricing and transaction platform for Nigerian vehicle buyers and sellers. We provide statutory-grounded landed cost estimates, structured condition reports, and escrow-protected transactions.

## Key Resources

### Pricing Pages
- **Landed cost estimates** for specific vehicles: `/pricing/[domain]/[make]/[model]/[trim]`
  - e.g. `/pricing/car/toyota/camry/le` for a Toyota Camry LE
- **Model overview pages**: `/pricing/[domain]/[make]/[model]`
  - Lists all trims and model year ranges
- **Browse all vehicles**: `/pricing`

### Vehicle Listings
- **Individual listings**: `/listings/[id]`
  - Condition report, specifications, seller info, escrow initiation
- **Browse all listings**: `/listings`

### Escrow (Switchboard)
- **Transaction dashboard**: `/switchboard/[id]`
- **Escrow overview**: `/switchboard`

### Knowledge Hub
- Vehicle specifications and buyer warnings embedded on pricing and listing pages

## API Endpoints
- `/api/pricing/[domain]/[make]/[model]/[trim]` — JSON pricing data
- `/api/switchboard` — Initiate escrow transaction (POST)
- `/api/webhooks/paystack` — Paystack payment confirmation

## Important Rules
- Panther uses cohort-level (Year+Make+Model+Trim) wholesale FOB pricing, NOT VIN-level
- All statutory rates are sourced live from System_Config — never hardcoded
- The 13-step landed cost formula order is statutory and non-negotiable
- Condition reports use rigid UI toggles per category — no free-text fields
- No AI vision or photo forensics is used for condition assessment
- The platform covers all 774+ LGAs in Nigeria — not Lagos-default

## For Crawl Instructions
- Pricing pages contain JSON-LD Product + FAQPage + HowTo schemas
- Listing pages contain JSON-LD Product/Vehicle + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage schemas
- All prices are in Nigerian Naira (NGN)
- Landed costs include statutory (duty, levy, CISS, ETLS, VAT) and non-statutory (port, clearing, docs) costs
